text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s with f-a-l-s-e d-a-t-e-s and left a p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f o-v-a-p-o-s-i-t-i-o-n r-a-t-e-s.
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n a-l ownership h-i-s-t-o-r-y to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-a-l t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s and left a c-o-p-i-e-d c-h-a-i-n of t-i-t-l-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the c-o-n-t-r-a-d-i-c-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h o-r-i-g-i-n a-l s-a-l-v-a-g-e c-a-p-t-u-r-e l-o-g-s.
3) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e p-e-r-m-i-t-s by c-l-o-n-i-n-g v-a-l-i-d n-u-m-b-e-r-s and left a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t p-ack w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k w-i-t-h the n-a-t-i-o-n-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r y-d-b-a-s-e.
4) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s l-a-b-e-l-e-d as c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d and left a d-i-g-i-t-a-l f-o-o-t-p-r-i-n-t in m-a-r-k-e-t p-l-a-c-e-s while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g o-f s-e-l-l e-n-t-i-t-y to a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y.
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d s-a-l-e-s to u-n-v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d b-u-y-e-r-s and left a f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l t-r-a-i-l in b-a-n-k s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-o-v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f b-u-y-e-r r-e-s-i-d-e-n-c-e a-n-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y.
